programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Acrylic Landscapes
programs.description: Discover the beauty of landscape painting in this hands-on acrylic workshop designed for beginners. Learn how to transform a blank canvas into a vibrant natural scene using colour, texture, layering, and composition techniques. Materials list will be provided.    This course is also offered as a four-week intensive.

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Yoga/Pilates Fusion
programs.description: Yoga and Pilates movements are combined to create a unique fitness experience. Focusing on body alignment and overall flexibility, you will learn fundamentals from both practices to improve your strength, coordination and relaxation.

programs.name: Youth Council
programs.description: Join your local Youth Council for the opportunity to gain valuable life experiences. This informal board, that gives a voice for youth in the community and is typically associated with an organization or a government body, like a municipality, provides recommendations and guidance around issues affecting young people. In addition to informing government, Youth Council members may also act upon issues of importance to them and facilitate the involvement of young people in local governance and decision-making. Youth Council’s also facilitate the engagement of young people into fundraising efforts and in various community events. Fostering a positive, youth-friendly environment, this activity is the perfect way to get involved.

programs.name: Youth Council
programs.description: Join your local Youth Council for the opportunity to gain valuable life experiences. This informal board, that gives a voice for youth in the community and is typically associated with an organization or a government body, like a municipality, provides recommendations and guidance around issues affecting young people. In addition to informing government, Youth Council members may also act upon issues of importance to them and facilitate the involvement of young people in local governance and decision-making. Youth Council’s also facilitate the engagement of young people into fundraising efforts and in various community events. Fostering a positive, youth-friendly environment, this activity is the perfect way to get involved.

programs.name: Abstract in a Day
programs.description: Spend a day experimenting,  playing and creating in this hands-on abstract painting intensive. Designed  for busy creatives, explore palette knives, brushes, taping, pouring, collage and other techniques while drawing inspiration from historical and contemporary  abstraction. Create a series of experimental pieces throughout the day before  bringing your favourite techniques together in one bold, completely unique  final artwork. No experience necessary—just  come ready to experiment and make something your own!

programs.name: Yoga/Pilates Fusion
programs.description: Yoga and Pilates movements are combined to create a unique fitness experience. Focusing on body alignment and overall flexibility, you will learn fundamentals from both practices to improve your strength, coordination and relaxation.

programs.name: Youth Council
programs.description: Join your local Youth Council for the opportunity to gain valuable life experiences. This informal board, that gives a voice for youth in the community and is typically associated with an organization or a government body, like a municipality, provides recommendations and guidance around issues affecting young people. In addition to informing government, Youth Council members may also act upon issues of importance to them and facilitate the involvement of young people in local governance and decision-making. Youth Council’s also facilitate the engagement of young people into fundraising efforts and in various community events. Fostering a positive, youth-friendly environment, this activity is the perfect way to get involved.

programs.name: Adapted Multi-Sport
programs.description: Instructional sports programs are designed to introduce sport-specific skills while improving fundamental movement with agility, balance and coordination. In this adapted version of multi-sport, as you learn the basics of a variety of sports like soccer, basketball and volleyball through drills, practice and play, you will also develop confidence in both your game and team play as you interact and have fun with peers.Participants must have a current AIS membership. To register contact the AIS Hotline at 416-395-6128 or email aiscw@toronto.ca.

programs.name: Bronze Star
programs.description: This course develops swimming proficiency, lifesaving skill and personal fitness. Candidates refine their stroke mechanics, acquire self-rescue skills, and apply fitness principles in training workouts. Bronze Star is excellent preparation for success in Bronze Medallion and provides a fun introduction to lifesaving sport.Prerequisite: Minimum age of 9 years old.

programs.name: Cartooning
programs.description: Learn the various styles of cartooning. As you practice and perfect basic drawing skills you will move into illustrating scenes, demonstrating motion and creating characters with expressive faces that you can incorporate into single-box and multi-boxes cartoons.

programs.name: Crafty Creations
programs.description: Are you ready to create? From making and cutting patterns to choosing colours and decorative elements, you will use a variety of arts and crafts materials, your hands and your imagination, to make unique craft projects.

programs.name: Dance: Ballet
programs.description: This classic style of dance is all about graceful movements. Learn basic ballet positions, postures and proper technique through various exercises and engaging choreography.

programs.name: Dance: Hip Hop
programs.description: Hip Hop is a street dance that uses strong, fast and fluid movements. Learn basic steps like body rolls, contractions, bounces and waves through a variety of exercises and engaging choreography.

programs.name: Dance: Kuthu
programs.description: Encompassing both ancient traditions and contemporary styles. Popular forms include classical Persian court dances, chain dances like Baba Karam and Bandari, regional dances like Azerbaijan and Lori, and spiritual practices like Sama. Learn traditional dance steps, footwork and hand movements through a variety of exercises and engaging choreography.
